s12.text: הַשְׁכִּיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וְהַעֲמִידֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לְחַיִּים וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ וְתַקְּנֵנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵנוּ וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ אוֹיֵב דֶּבֶר וְחֶרֶב וְרָעָב וְיָגוֹן וְהָסֵר שָׂטָן מִלְּפָנֵינוּ וּמֵאַחֲרֵינוּ וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנוּ כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמְרֵנוּ וּמַצִּילֵנוּ אָתָּה כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵנוּ וּבוֹאֵנוּ לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם. וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַפּוֹרֵשׂ סֻכַּת שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלָם:

s13.text: Evening Prayer for the New Year

Lead us to rest, O Lord our God, in peace, and let us rise, O our King, to life. Spread over us the tent of Thy peace and improve us through good counsel from before Thee. Help us for the sake of Thy Name, protect us and remove from us foe, pestilence, sword, famine and grief. Remove Satan from in front of us and behind us; and in the shadow of Thy wings shelter us, for Thou art God, our guardian and our deliverer, for Thou art God, a gracious and merciful King. Guard our going out and our return to life and peace from now to eternity. Spread over us the tent of Thy peace. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who spreads the tent of peace over us and over all His people Israel and over Jerusalem.
Blow the Shofar on the New Moon when the moon is covered on the day of our festival, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob.
And now let the power of the Lord appear great, as Thou hast said. Remember Thy compassion, O Lord, and Thy kindnesses, for they exist since eternity.

Exalted and sanctified be His Great Name in the world which He has created according to His will. May His Kingdom be established in your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of the whole House of Israel, speedily and in a short time, and say: Amen!
s13.note: There is a small blemish dot just before 'His will'. It is not punctuation and is not encoded.

s13.text: May His Great Name be praised to eternity and the eternity of eternities!

Blessed and praised and glorified and elevated and exalted and adorned and raised on high and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He; high, yea high, above all blessing and song, praise and comfort that have ever been spoken in the world, and say Amen!
